name: Algebraic_Float_Trap
description: Redefines the independent server load conditions using an algebraically equivalent "margin" formula (T/j - p) whose sum must be strictly negative. Models that blindly pattern-match and translate this to floating-point code will suffer precision errors on edge cases where sum(p) == T, resulting in Wrong Answer. Models that genuinely reason will algebraically simplify sum(T/j - p) < 0 to sum(p) > T and use safe integer arithmetic.
